meta.title: For tuition teachers
meta.description: ReMix for a teacher with up to {max, number} students. Your own website, fees and bank slips, Zoom classes and protected lessons in one place, set up for you in a day.

hero.title: You teach. ReMix runs the class.
hero.subtitle: For a teacher with up to {max, number} students. Your website, fees, Zoom classes and protected lessons in one place, set up for you in a day.

plan.label: Example monthly price for a teacher with {students, number} students
plan.assumption: Assumes {classes} classes per student at {perCard} per class card.

saturday.title: A Saturday with ReMix.
saturday.subtitle: One teacher, one hall, 120 students in the morning batch. Here's what you no longer do by hand.

gate.title: Students scan in at the hall door
gate.body: Unpaid students are flagged at the gate, not in the middle of your lesson.

zoom.title: Zoom students join under their own names
zoom.body: No shared links. Attendance from Zoom is recorded next to the hall list.

recording.title: You upload the recording
recording.body: ReMix encrypts it and adds each viewer's student ID as a moving watermark.

sms.title: Parents of absent students get an SMS
sms.body: Sent automatically, in the parent's language.

slips.title: You approve 12 bank slips from your phone
slips.body: Slip on the left, expected amount on the right. Press A to approve.

website.title: A website with your name
website.body: yourname.remix.lk with your photo, classes, timetable and an Enrol button.

fees.title: Fees without the notebook
fees.body: Card, bank slip or cash, all in one list. See who hasn't paid for October in one tap.

lessons.title: Lessons only paid students see
lessons.body: Each month's recordings unlock when that month is paid. Downloading is turned off.

devices.title: Two devices per student
devices.body: One login can't be shared around a WhatsApp group. Students sign out old phones themselves.

tutes.title: Tutes and papers
tutes.body: Share PDFs by class and month. No more printing for students who missed the day.

languages.title: Sinhala, Tamil or English
languages.body: You, your students and their parents each use the language they prefer.

switch.title: Switch in three steps. We do the heavy lifting.

list.title: Send us your student list
list.body: Excel, CSV, or a photo of your register book.

setup.title: We set up your classes and website
setup.body: Fees, timetable and your site, ready to check.

share.title: Share one link with your students
share.body: They sign in with their phone number and pay.

switch.whatsappPrefill: Hi ReMix, I'd like to move my class to ReMix. Can I send you my student list?
switch.mockupLabel: The student portal on a phone, where your students sign in, pay the fee and join the live class. Sample data.

finalCta.title: Run next month's class on ReMix.
